Usage: hm ai-init [-|--platforms] [-|--types] [-|--resources] [-|--repository] [-|--branch] [-|--plugin] 
Example: hm ai-init
	 hm ai-init --platforms=claude,cursor --types=hyva,magento --resources=skills,agents
Description: Initialize AI tools configuration (skills/agents) via interactive wizard
Options:
   [-|--platforms]  Comma-separated list of AI platforms (claude, cursor, codex, copilot, gemini, opencode, generic)
   [-|--types]      Comma-separated list of skill types (hyva, acs, magento, php)
   [-|--resources]  Resource types to download (skills, agents, or both)
   [-|--repository] Custom repository URL to include
   [-|--branch]     Branch name for custom repository (default: main)
   [-|--plugin]     Only write a Claude Code plugin (default: ~/.hm/claude-plugin)
